output.report_thesis: The outlook frames technology and media strategy around competing for consumer attention, navigating platform control of discovery and messaging, and responding to shifts across media markets and household structures.

themes.theme: Consumer multitasking and projected internet-and-media revenue growth by segment.
Annual ARPU leaders differ between the U.S. and global comparisons.
Platform capabilities and commercial discovery arrangements shape publishers’ visibility and traffic; messaging and bots raise questions of platform control and monetization.
eSports forecasts sit alongside conditions the report identifies for the category to reach its potential.
Pay TV pricing and consumer reasons for not subscribing inform the report’s analysis of video competition.
The audio section examines music piracy and subsequent legal service models, alongside changes in home audio.
Post-household sharing behaviors and barriers among underserved Americans inform the report’s recommended approaches to reaching users.
